_readme: Exceptions for scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs. Each entry needs a reason.
{ "path": "<glob>", "rule": "<pattern id>", "reason": "..." } — a fake key in a fixture (prefer building fakes at runtime instead).
{ "fingerprint": "<16 hex from the scan output>", "reason": "revoked YYYY-MM-DD ..." } — one specific value, e.g. a revoked key that stays in git history.
Only allowlist a real key AFTER it has been revoked at the provider.
